name: Haruka na Koi
source:
The protagonist, Sakurai Haruka, is your average office lady.
Due to some missteps from her school days, she started shying away from romance.
Out of the blue, three men come into her life.

Her childhood friend, who had been pining for her all that time - Youta.
A barkeeper at "Lecker" - Takumi.
Last, but not least; the guy she used to date in school - Yuuto.

Is the universe playing a joke on her? Or is this her chance?

"Love isn't as pretty as TV would tell you.
I might get jealous, but any amount of praise will brighten my mood.

Still, I don't want to be shy anymore.
I want to change myself."

Haruka's (your) choices can alter the future drastically.

[translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ010870.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公樱井晴花是一名普通的上班族女性。
学生时代的一些挫折，让她开始对恋爱望而却步。
然而，三个男人突然闯入了她的生活。

一直默默喜欢着她的青梅竹马——阳太。
“Lecker”酒吧的调酒师——拓臣。
还有她学生时代交往过的前男友——悠人。

这是命运在捉弄她，还是属于她的机会？

“恋爱并不像电视剧里演的那样美好。
我会吃醋，可哪怕只被夸上一句，心情也会好起来。

但我不想再这样畏首畏尾了。
我想改变自己。”

晴花，也就是你的选择，将会让未来发生巨大的变化。

（译自：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ010870.html]DLsite[/url]）
